original.statement: With Dex SSO, Argo CD 3.0 bases the RBAC subject on the federated_claims.user_id claim (requesting the federated:id scope) instead of the sub claim, so RBAC policies that reference the Dex sub claim must be updated to keep the same access.

decision.reason: [ev-0b6150153730] says that with Dex, the RBAC subject used to come from the `sub` claim. In 3.0 it comes from the `federated_claims.user_id` claim, and Argo CD now requests the `federated:id` scope. The configuration stays the same but its meaning changes, so behavior-changed with before "sub claim" and after "federated_claims.user_id claim" matches the text. The subject name dex-rbac-subject-claim is built only from the evidence's own words. It fits protocol-behavior (how a token claim is used) better than rbac-permission, because no permission is granted or removed.
